question: A steel rod of 4 cm diameter and 14 cm length is used in the making of solid cubical dice. If the length of each side of each dice is 4 mm, then how many such dice can be made from this rod? [Use π = frac{{22}}{7}]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert units to mm: r = 20 mm, h = 140 mm, a = 4 mm.

Number of dice = Volume of cylindrical rod ÷ Volume of one dice

Number of dice = (π × r² × h) ÷ a³

Number of dice = (22/7 × 20² × 140) ÷ 4³ = 176000 ÷ 64

Number of dice = 2750

**∴ The correct answer is 2750 dice.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the rod = 4 cm ⇒ Radius (r) = 2 cm = 20 mm

Length of the rod (h) = 14 cm = 140 mm

Side of one cubical dice (a) = 4 mm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cylinder = π × r² × h

Volume of cube = a³

Number of dice = Volume of cylinder ÷ Volume of one dice
